description:
OpenStreetMap Anti-Surveillance survey app for Android ASComplete is an OpenStreetMap anti-surveillance surveying application designed to easily add, edit, and audit surveillance infrastructure in the OSM database. Counter Surveillance Features:
  • Add camera nodes and surveillance POIs directly on the map
  • Interactive camera:direction estimation and editing
  • Specify mount type (camera:mount), camera type, surveillance type, and surveillance zones
  • NSI support for camera types
  • Quest system with a StreetComplete / EveryDoor style interface to quickly fill in missing surveillance tags
Privacy & Network Controls:
  • Proxy Support: Route all OpenStreetMap network traffic through a custom proxy
  • Direct in-app OpenStreetMap OAuth authentication
  • Direct download and upload of OpenStreetMap data changesets
Map & Navigation:
  • Built with Jetpack Compose and MapLibre
  • Multiple tile layer map styles supported (including Esri)
  • Native GPS location tracking and interactive map controls
  • Direct element tag editing for advanced users
